data.description: If a totenmaske hits a single creature with both claw attacks, the hollow claws drain away some of the target's flesh, dealing 1d6 points of Constitution damage and making the victim sickened for 1d4 rounds.  A successful DC %1 Fortitude save negates the Constitution damage and reduces the sickened condition duration to 1 round.
data.name: Fleshdrink
